system.summary: Unspaced continuous digits using two-digit letter codes (with homophones) interleaved with single-digit nulls (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) and two-digit nulls (01, 04); separate key from targets/francia346 (Ceva).
system.sibling_key: Distinct from targets/ceva1632 and targets/francia346 (tested in scripts/test_ceva_mismatch.py with R5635 as positive control).

prior_solution.where: Contemporary clerk's decipherment on the leaves in Francia 346; not opened before freezing the key (FROZEN.sha256).

conditions.human_role: Built the pipeline, chose the records, froze the ciphertext-only read before checking any clerk text, and approved publication.

solution.what: Machine transcription of six DECODE pages (R5634 ff. 190r-190v, R5638 ff. 218r-218v, R5639 ff. 220r-220v; 86 rows, 6,420 digits, 127 unread gaps). Not verified by a person.

59-code key recovered from ciphertext alone (18 firm core two-digit letters, homophones, 8 single-digit nulls, 2 two-digit nulls, and 22 tentative rare codes), frozen in branicki-1757 commit 681ed424 (2026-11-22 21:34:50 UTC-5; FROZEN.sha256) before opening any clerk's decipherment on the leaves.

Reproducible unedited mechanical decode (scripts/decode.py) and Ceva-key mismatch test (scripts/test_ceva_mismatch.py) on lang/lexicons/it.json.gz with R5635 positive control and 100 digit-shuffled controls: Ceva fits R5635 (23.1% >=5-letter word coverage, Z=+4.4) and fails on R5638/R5639 (4.1%/8.2%), whereas key.tsv fits R5638/R5639 (45.3%/42.5%, Z=+28.0/+28.2) and fails on R5635 (0.0%, Z=+0.3).

outcome.method_basis: 59-code unspaced 1- and 2-digit key recovered from ciphertext alone and applied mechanically via scripts/decode.py; clerk's decipherments on the leaves were not opened.

texts.label: R5634, ff. 190r-190v
texts.summary: Short, broken letter (54 unread gaps) touching on compensation for pensions ('ricompenza delle queste penzioni'), letting a pension suffer ('far patire la penzione'), and a particular obligation ('tenuto particolarmente'). (Working guess from the decode; not a reading.)
texts.note: 23 rows, 1211 digits, 557 letters, 122 nulls, 54 gaps. Decoded, not read; cipher words not counted.

texts.label: R5638, ff. 218r-218v
texts.summary: Cleanest of the three records (16 unread gaps): an enclosed letter ('l'agiunta lettera') and separate cipher sheet ('un foglio di cifra') to V.E., considering renouncing a priory ('il priorato', 'il renuntiarglielo'), taking four thousand scudi ('pigliare li quattro mila scudi') on provision to reimburse himself rather than serve as a salaried servant ('servitore provizionato'), written in great confidence. (Working guess from the decode; not a reading.)
texts.note: 33 rows, 2874 digits, 1361 letters, 153 nulls, 16 gaps. Decoded, not read; cipher words not counted.

texts.label: R5639, ff. 220r-220v
texts.summary: Companion letter to R5638 (57 unread gaps) on the same priory and pension settlement ('con penzione, nell'altra ricompenza', 'aggiungere il dar di quattro', 'l'equivalente del priorato ... pigliare il rimanente', 'non per interesse di veruna sorte', 'in risposta l'avviso del suo arrivo'). (Working guess from the decode; not a reading.)
texts.note: 30 rows, 2335 digits, 1103 letters, 134 nulls, 57 gaps. Decoded, not read; cipher words not counted.
